en.name: Winged bean
en.summary: The winged bean is a tropical pod with four frilled ridges running its length, eaten young and crisp. Refrigerated it runs about 3–5 days. No agency publishes a figure for it, so that range is borrowed from the FoodKeeper line covering green, fava, lima, soy, wax and snow beans.
en.pantry: Fresh pods do not keep at room temperature. The frilled edges are thin and they brown and dry before the body of the pod shows any change, so a bunch left on the counter looks tired within a day. There is no counter-storage figure to give; refrigerate on the day of purchase.
en.fridge: Bag the pods and keep them in the crisper at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, using them within about 3–5 days. That range is borrowed from the general fresh-bean entry rather than published for winged beans specifically. Store them dry and unwashed; the wings hold water in their folds and slime up quickly if you bag them wet. Judge freshness by the wings — while they are still crisp and green the pod is good.
en.freezer: There is no freezer timeline for winged beans. If you want to keep some, treat them as you would any fresh bean: trim, blanch briefly, chill in iced water, dry and freeze in a sealed bag at −18 °C (0 °F). Frozen food held at that temperature stays safe indefinitely, but expect the frilled edges to lose their crispness, which is most of the reason for eating this pod.
en.thawing: Cook blanched, frozen pods straight from the freezer in a hot pan or boiling water. Thawing them first leaves them limp and watery.
spoilage: Wings browned, dried or shrivelled along the edges
Pods that bend limply instead of snapping
Slimy or dark patches, especially in the folds of the wings
Visible bulging seeds and a tough, fibrous pod — over-mature rather than spoiled, but no longer good eating
tips: Pick pods with crisp, undamaged wings and no seed bulges showing through.
Store dry and unwashed; wash only just before cooking.
Slice across the pod so each piece keeps its four-pointed star shape.
Buy for the next few days rather than for the week.

faq.q: How long do winged beans last in the fridge?
faq.a: About 3–5 days bagged at 4 °C or below. That figure is borrowed from the general fresh-bean entry, not published for winged beans.
There is no published timeline. Blanch them first if you want to freeze them, and accept that the frilled wings will lose their crunch.

faq.q: How do you tell if a winged bean is too old?
faq.a: Look at the wings and the seeds. Browned, dried wings or seeds bulging through the pod mean it will be tough and fibrous.

faq.q: Do you need to peel winged beans?
faq.a: No. Trim the ends and slice them across; the wings are part of the appeal and are eaten with the pod.

zh.name: 四角豆
zh.summary: 四角豆是熱帶豆莢，整條有四道帶皺褶的稜，要趁嫩趁脆吃。冷藏大約可放 3～5 天。沒有機構為它發表過數字，這個範圍是比照 FoodKeeper 涵蓋四季豆、蠶豆、皇帝豆、毛豆、黃四季豆與甜豆的那一筆資料來看的。
zh.pantry: 新鮮豆莢無法常溫保存。稜邊很薄，會在整條豆莢還看不出變化之前就先變褐、變乾，所以放在檯面上一天看起來就疲了。這裡沒有常溫天數可以給；買回來當天就要冷藏。
zh.fridge: 裝袋放進 4 °C 以下的蔬果室，大約 3～5 天內用完。這個範圍是比照新鮮豆類的通用數字，不是針對四角豆發表的。請乾燥、不清洗存放；稜的皺褶會積水，帶水裝袋很快就會變黏。判斷新鮮度就看那四道稜——還脆還綠就還好。
zh.freezer: 四角豆沒有冷凍期限。真的想留，就比照其他新鮮豆類處理：切好、快速汆燙、冰水冰鎮、擦乾，密封在 −18 °C 冷凍。食物在這個溫度下安全性可以無限期維持，但要有心理準備：皺褶邊會失去脆度，而那正是吃這種豆莢的主要理由。
zh.thawing: 汆燙後冷凍的豆莢請直接下熱鍋或滾水，不要先解凍；先解凍會變得軟爛出水。
spoilage: 四道稜邊發褐、乾掉或皺縮
豆莢彎折時軟軟地彎過去，而不是脆斷
出現黏滑或發暗的區塊，特別是在稜的皺褶裡
豆仁明顯凸出、豆莢變老變柴——這是過熟不是腐壞，但已經不好吃
tips: 挑稜邊脆挺完整、看不出豆仁凸起的。
乾燥、不清洗存放，下鍋前才洗。
橫切成片，每一片都會保留四角星形。
買未來幾天吃得完的量，不要買一週份。

faq.q: 四角豆放冰箱可以放多久？
faq.a: 裝袋放在 4 °C 以下大約 3～5 天。這個數字是比照新鮮豆類的通用資料，不是四角豆自己的。
沒有已發表的期限。想冷凍請先汆燙，並接受稜邊的脆度會消失。
看稜邊和豆仁。稜邊發褐乾掉，或豆仁從豆莢凸出來，就代表口感會老而多纖維。
不用。切掉兩端橫切成片即可；那四道稜正是它好吃的地方，連著豆莢一起吃。
